name: g3 NetworX UG & Co. KG
notes:
IPv6-only network operated by g3 NetworX UG (haftungsbeschränkt) & Co. KG, AS218229.

Address space and routing:
- Originated aggregates: 2a0c:9a40:e080::/48, 2a09:3f00:3f00::/40 and 2a09:3f00:1017::/48 (new allocation enabled 2026-11-24); only these exact prefixes are announced externally.
- Valid RPKI ROAs and RIPE route6 objects for origin AS218229 on all three prefixes.
- IRR AS-SET: RIPE::AS218229:AS-G3NETWORX. It contains only our own origin AS218229; no downstream autonomous systems are included.
- Routing infrastructure: Frankfurt am Main, Germany (RTFRA1-3), Amsterdam, Netherlands (RTAMS1, RTAMS2), and Duesseldorf, Germany (RTDUS1). Customer and internal services are delivered over routed, encrypted tunnels.

IPv6 transit (listed in order of outbound preference):
- LowPing NL, AS215296, RTAMS1 (Amsterdam): primary IPv6 transit since 2026-11-05. The BGP default route is accepted and preferred throughout our backbone; exports contain only our exact registered aggregates without additional prepends. Direct own-prefix reachability and the site paths have been validated.
- iFOG, AS34927, RTFRA3 (Frankfurt): first reserve transit behind RTAMS1. Exports contain only our exact registered aggregates with one additional prepend.
- Virtua.Cloud, AS35661, RTFRA1 (Frankfurt): second reserve transit with two redundant BGP sessions. Exports contain only our exact registered aggregates with one additional prepend.
- Senko Digital, AS213520, RTFRA2 (Frankfurt): last reserve transit. BGP is used only to advertise our exact registered aggregates without additional prepends; no routes are learned from Senko. The native Senko IPv6 path is continuously health-checked from our own prefix and is distributed as a reserve default inside our backbone only while these checks succeed.

- Servperso, AS34872, RTDUS1 (Duesseldorf): additional reserve transit operational since 2026-11-24. Import is restricted to ::/0; exports are restricted to our exact registered aggregates, with one additional prepend. Native own-prefix HTTPS reachability has been validated for both aggregates. A readiness guard withdraws this session if the encrypted ESP site path is unhealthy; existing primary uplink preferences are retained.

Public peering:
- Tempest AS36231: bilateral IPv6 peering configured on RTAMS1 at Frys-IX on 2026-11-28; peer 2001:7f8:10f::8d87:22, local 2001:7f8:10f::3:5475:128. Awaiting remote activation; the bilateral session is not yet established and no bilateral route exchange is claimed. Import is restricted to IRR-registered, RPKI-valid IPv6 prefixes from RIPE::AS36231:AS-ALL with a maximum of 100 accepted prefixes. Exports contain only our three exact locally originated aggregates. Existing Frys-IX route-server sessions remain operational.
- Open IPv6 peering policy; please contact our peering team to coordinate a session.
- FogIXP Europe: 1 Gbps virtual port provisioned through iFOG on RTFRA3 (Frankfurt). Assigned IPv6 peering address: 2001:7f8:ca:1::21:8229:1. Operational IPv6 peering with redundant route-server sessions to AS47498 (RS-111, RS-222 and RS-333). Imports accept only RPKI-valid global IPv6 prefixes; exports are restricted to our exact registered aggregates. The validated routes are available throughout our internal backbone.
- Frys-IX (Amsterdam): operational virtual 1 Gbps access through LowPing NL on RTAMS1 since 2026-11-05; IPv6 peering address 2001:7f8:10f::3:5475:128/64. Both IPv6 route-server sessions to AS56393 (2001:7f8:10f::dc49:1 and 2001:7f8:10f::dc49:2) are established. Imports accept only RPKI-valid global IPv6 prefixes through /48; exports contain only our exact locally originated aggregates (/48, /40). Validated peering routes are distributed throughout our internal backbone.
- Nine-IX: operational virtual 1 Gbps access through LowPing NL on RTAMS1 since 2026-11-21; IPv6 peering address 2001:7f8:12e::21:8229:1/64. Both IPv6 route-server sessions to AS31561 (RS Blue 2001:7f8:12e::1:b and RS Red 2001:7f8:12e::1:f) are established. Imports accept only RPKI-valid global IPv6 prefixes through /48; exports contain only our exact locally originated aggregates (/48, /40). Validated peering routes are distributed throughout our internal backbone. The assigned IPv4 address is configured for port provisioning only; there are no IPv4 BGP sessions.
- PITER-IX Frankfurt: virtual access through LowPing NL on RTAMS2 (Amsterdam) is being provisioned (since 2026-11-22); not yet operational. IPv6-only route-server peering with the same policy as above (RPKI-valid imports only; exports limited to our exact aggregates /48 and /40).
- LOCIX Duesseldorf: operational IPv6 peering via Servperso on RTDUS1; address 2a0c:b641:701::a5:21:8229:1/64. Both route-server sessions to AS202409 are established. Imports accept only RPKI-valid global IPv6 prefixes through /48; exports are restricted to our exact locally originated aggregates. The former LOCIX Frankfurt handoff has been repurposed for ixFabric; no active LOCIX Frankfurt peering is claimed.
- ixFabric Duesseldorf: local Layer-2 handoff through Servperso on RTDUS1, WIIT Datacenter. Assigned IPv6 address 2a0e:8f01:1000:46::174/64; route server 2a0e:8f01:1000:46::1, AS24381. Address conflict resolved on 2026-11-27. The local Layer-2 attachment is operational and matches the IXP IX-F feed. BGP to AS24381 is configured and retrying but is not yet established; no successful route exchange is claimed. Imports are restricted to RPKI-valid global IPv6 prefixes through /48; exports to our exact locally originated aggregates.
- Transit BGP sessions listed above are not IXP memberships. Frys-IX, Nine-IX and PITER-IX Frankfurt are delivered through a reseller (LowPing NL); no direct rack or facility presence is claimed.

Internal routing is configured and tested across all six routers and the ESP site. Reverse DNS is delegated to dns1/dns2/dns3.g3nx.net and DNSSEC-signed. External export of this additional exact /48 was enabled on all six routers on 2026-11-24. All 13 established external IPv6 BGP sessions advertise it; provider IRR-filter updates and remote acceptance may still be pending.
